import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

xmlwf = next(p.resolve() for p in Path("build-panel").rglob("xmlwf") if p.is_file() and os.access(p, os.X_OK))
# Numeric percent references keep the replacement text unexpanded at declaration.
chain = '<!ENTITY % e0 "x">' + "".join(
    f'<!ENTITY % e{i} "%e{i-1};%e{i-1};">' for i in range(1, 65)
)
tests = {
    "ordinary_comment": '<!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY % p "<!--text-->">%p;]><r/>',
    "literal_self_in_comment": '<!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY % p "<!--%p;-->">%p;]><r/>',
    "literal_large_in_comment": '<!DOCTYPE r [' + chain + '<!ENTITY % p "<!--%e64;-->">%p;]><r/>',
    "real_cycle": '<!DOCTYPE r [<!ENTITY % p "%p;">%p;]><r/>',
}
record = {}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "document.xml"
    for label, document in tests.items():
        path.write_text(document)
        proc = subprocess.run([str(xmlwf), "-p", str(path)], capture_output=True, timeout=6)
        message = (proc.stdout + proc.stderr).decode(errors="replace").lower()
        record[label] = {"exit": proc.returncode, "amplification": "amplification" in message,
                         "recursive": "recursive" in message}
print(json.dumps(record))

"""Run from a libarchive grade tree with the pinned MinGW sysroot in LIBARCHIVE_MINGW_HEADERS."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

include = Path("libarchive")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    Path(folder, "config.h").write_text("".join(
        f"#define HAVE_{name}_H 1\n" for name in ("FCNTL", "ERRNO", "SYS_TYPES", "STDINT", "INTTYPES", "WCHAR")
    ))
    args = ["clang-18", "--target=x86_64-w64-windows-gnu", "--sysroot=" + os.environ["LIBARCHIVE_MINGW_HEADERS"],
            "-E", "-Wno-everything", "-DHAVE_CONFIG_H", "-I" + folder, "-Ilibarchive"]
    macros = subprocess.run([*args, "-dM", "-x", "c", "-"], input='#include "archive_platform.h"\n#include <fcntl.h>\n',
                            text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
    active = [line for line in macros.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith(("#define fcntl(", "#define F_GETFL ", "#define O_APPEND "))]
    output = subprocess.run([*args, str(include / "archive_read_data_into_fd.c"), "-o", os.devnull],
                            text=True, capture_output=True)
    print(json.dumps({"clang": subprocess.check_output(["clang-18", "--version"], text=True).splitlines()[0],
                      "target": "x86_64-w64-windows-gnu", "macros": sorted(active), "exit": output.returncode,
